I like this product, not the greatest but good for the price.  PROS: -Cheap -You don't feel bad about scratching them -A lot of cute designs that are non floral unlike KONAD (a lot of floral) -Full finger design fits me just fine except for the thumb (it's a bit small) -Plenty of designs to choose from  CONS: -Edges are really SHARP -The bigger designs tend to smear -Disregarded some of the larger designs because it just looked like a blob even after I scraped it thin -The metal is a lot thinner

reviews.t: They are GREAT better than Konad!
reviews.x: I loved my Bundle Monster IP's they are soo cool. Fast shipping I ordered Tuesday and received them on Friday. The images are soo many to pick from its like a kid at a candy store LOL. I think they are better than Konad I have 10 Konad IP's and with Konad you can't get every single part of the image BUT with the Bundle Monster you can with the very first try! I got my family and friends wanting to buy the Bundle Monster IP's. I would really love to see what else Bundle Monster comes up with next

I was so close to returning these today after having them a month and getting more and more irritated that they weren't picking up the nail polish or working. I read a few reviews today to figure out why they were all talking about it working and finally got it through my thick skull that there is a PROTECTIVE LAYER on top. Peeled it off and all the scratches came off too of course. Now I'm itching to get back to painting. So please, peel off that layer.

This is my first non-Konad stamping nail plates and I'm in love. They are super easy to use with some great and fun designs. Considering I'm a very new stamper, I've had great success. I do wish the full plates were a smidge larger. I have larger nail beds and have to double stamp with these. But, so far I've used them on every single manicure I've done since receiving them.  I hope they have a new set of 21 coming out soon! I'd also love to see them create and distribute their own line of polis

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: These plates are just cheaper (price-wise and quality) versions of Konad plates. You get 21 plates for about $18, and shipping is free, so that's quite an irresistible deal, but I have to say, these plates CANNOT compare to the Konad plates. First of all, there is no safety backing on the plates, as many people have written already; the plates are very thin, and can be very sharp. I resorted to pasting the plates to index cards so it's less likely to slice into my fingers, and to prevent the pla

The plates are exactly the same size as the Konad brand plates and they are the same thickness as well. I mention this because I read some reviews saying the plates are a little smaller/thinner than the Konad plates, but they aren't. They're the same size. While I am not disappointed in the quantity of images you get when you order the Bundle Monster Image Plates, I am quite sad with the quality of the images. Some of the images refuse to transfer regardless of what kind of polish I'm using. I've had mediocre luck with them at best. Also, I have pretty normal-sized nail beds, but the full-nail images don't cover them at all. This, in my opinion, was a major oversight in production. Or they did it on purpose to fit more images on each plate. Either

These plates have many designs and they're not etched in too shallow making them very easy to use. The only possible downside is that you should have a stamper before ordering these because one isn't included and you have to be careful when peeling the plastic film off, but you can't forget that 21 plates for $18 is an awesome bargain. And the sellers shipping is very fast my plates arrived four days after ordering.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the low price and value, often comparing it favorably to the much more expensive Konad brand.
Many customers report the plates work well and are easy to use, with a wide variety of cute, unique designs.
Some reviewers complain that certain designs are not etched deep enough and fail to transfer polish properly.
Several reviewers note that the full-nail designs are too small for larger nail beds, requiring double stamping or not covering the thumb.
A few reviewers mention the plates lack a safety backing or feel like a cheaper-quality version of Konad.

qa.q: Do these plates work with any stamping polish?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Are the designs etched deep enough to pick up cleanly?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says some designs seem not etched very deeply and are tricky to use [1], while another says the plates are not etched too shallow and are very easy to use [2].

claims.text: Some designs seem not to be etched very deeply and are tricky to use.
The plates are not etched too shallow, making them very easy to use.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is the metal sharp or safe to handle?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on safety: some report the edges are really sharp [1][6], while others describe the plates as thin but usable with gentle care [2].

claims.text: The plates are slightly thinner than Konad but should be cared for and used gently.
